title: Christmas quilt
text: Christmas quilt. This is actually prettier than I imagined in person.  It washed and dried beautifully. It is soft and lightweight.  The colors are perfect for my decor - there is a bit more smokey blue than I was expecting, but it fits in my room. I love the sweet birds on the print.  I like that this is not an overly 'Christmas' quilt.  A great seasonal quilt.  Just love it.  Having said that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Levtex Home - Holly - Decorative Pillow (14X18in.) - Postcard - Red, White, Black and Grey
features: THE HOLLY DESIGN: One of our most popular collections Holly is inspired by snowy woods on Christmas morning. This postcard and bird pillow is a great accessory for any bedroom, family room, living room or den.
SOFT AND COMFORTABLE LUXURY: Made from quality fabrics, the Holly pillow comes with a removable feather filling, making the cover easier to care for.

COORDINATE YOUR HOLIDAY DECOR: Create a festive holiday space with our coordinated reversible Holly matching bed set. The red, white, black and grey pillow brings fun, holiday accents into your home . You can also freshen your room with matching quilt set, coordinating decorative pillows and quilted throw from the Levtex Home collection.
description: LEVTEX HOLLY COLLECTION: The Holly decorative pillow complements the Holly bedding collection. Use it to accessorize your bed, or on your living room couch or favorite chair. This pillow features a stylized vintage postcard with ornaments and a bird superimposed, all printed on a rich canvas and piped.
